book.title: SAMPLE: Salary Basics (DEMO)

definitions.definition: Any amount received by an employee from an employer as consideration for employment, whether of a revenue or capital nature.
An amount paid in addition to basic salary to meet specific expenses of the employee.

caveats: Synthetic demo pack for development. Not real tax content.

slides.text:
Salary means any amount, benefits or perquisites received by an employee from any employment, whether of a revenue or capital nature. [Sec. 12(2)]

Employee means any individual engaged in employment.
Employer means any person who engages and remunerates an employee.
slides.title: What is Salary? [Sec. 12(2)] (DEMO)

slides.text:
Allowances are amounts paid in addition to basic pay. Some allowances are fully taxable, some are exempt up to limits.

Example: A conveyance allowance of Rs 10,000 per month paid to an employee.
slides.title: Allowances (DEMO)

questions.solution: Correct option: (b). Salary is defined in section 12(2) of the Income Tax Ordinance, 2001.
questions.statement:
(DEMO) Salary is defined in which section of the Income Tax Ordinance, 2001?
(a) Section 12(1)
(b) Section 12(2)
(c) Section 13
(d) Section 15

questions.solution:
Step 1: Monthly allowance = Rs 10,000.
Step 2: Annual allowance = 10,000 x 12 = Rs 120,000.
Step 3: Taxable amount = Rs 120,000 (fully taxable in this demo).
questions.statement: (DEMO) An employee receives a conveyance allowance of Rs 10,000 per month. Compute the annual taxable allowance assuming it is fully taxable.
